description: "Modern Fiction" by Charles Dudley Warner is a critical examination of contemporary literature, written during the late 19th century. This work falls within the realm of literary criticism and addresses the evolving characteristics and themes of modern novels, particularly focusing on the balance between realism and artistic idealization.
